open_panel_tip: Open the QGIS Assistant chat panel
model_tip: Model - pick from the list or type any model id
chats_tip: Your chats - pick one to switch
project_context_tip: Send a description of your layers, fields, CRS and map extent
map_snapshot_tip: Attach an image of the map view (needs a vision-capable model)
auto_run_tip: Let the assistant run its code in your QGIS session by itself, read the result and continue until the task is done
input_placeholder: Ask anything... (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line, ↑/↓ for history)
add_key_first: Add an API key for {} first (⚙)
no_key_note: No API key for {}. Add one in ⚙ Settings.
choose_model: Choose or type a model name first.
max_steps: Stopped after {} automatic steps. Say "continue" to let the assistant keep going.
will_fix: the assistant will try to fix it
wait_answer: Wait for the answer to finish
ask_fix: Ask the AI to fix it
welcome_intro: Ask about GIS, or ask the assistant to do something with your project, for example:
welcome_ex1: Buffer the selected roads by 50 m and add the result as a new layer
welcome_ex2: Which layers are in a different CRS from the project?
welcome_ex3: Style the parcels layer by area with a graduated green ramp
welcome_ex4: Explain what this map shows (tick “Map snapshot”)
welcome_auto: With Auto-run on, the assistant runs its code in your QGIS session by itself, reads the result, and keeps going until the task is done. Choose the provider and model above; add API keys with ⚙.
refused: The model declined this request. The partial answer is not kept in the conversation.
truncated: The answer hit the output-token limit and was cut off.
content_filter: The provider's content filter stopped this answer.
err_check_key: check the API key in the plugin settings.
err_check_model: check the model name and base URL.
err_unreachable: is the server reachable? (local servers like Ollama must be running)
err_not_json: The server did not return JSON.
base_url_header: Base URL (leave empty for the default)
keys_note: Keys are stored in the QGIS authentication database, encrypted with your QGIS master password (QGIS may ask you to create or enter it).
max_tokens_tip: Claude only; capped automatically at each model's own limit once the model list has been refreshed.
plain_keys_question:
The keys could not be saved in the encrypted QGIS authentication database (the master password was not set or not entered).

Save them unencrypted in the QGIS settings file instead?
memory_learn_tip: When you ask the assistant to stop doing something, or keep asking for the same thing, it remembers it on this computer and applies it in every chat.
code_stopped: The code was stopped before it finished.
